decision: A complete immutable source-bearing bundle cannot currently be assembled from existing approved shared/local artifacts and local Git object databases without modifying occupied repositories.

exact_remaining_blocker.finding: The commit object is absent from all local Git object databases inspected. No project/shared Python file has the wrapper hash or class definition, and no plausible reachable or dangling blob in the three SpikeSortingTools-related object databases has the wrapper SHA-256. The reviewed wrapper packet deliberately records hashes but does not carry source payload bytes.
exact_remaining_blocker.minimum_supply: Any authorized source owner may publish an immutable full Git bundle containing commit aea7431c4026fa74e36ad01139d9e596900a1d25, or a source archive containing the complete tree plus an independently verifiable tree manifest. This is not assigned specifically to H1.

occupied_path_conflict.finding: The reviewed v3 runner enforces absolute paths inside the occupied SpikeSortingTools repository and its installed Kilosort site. The expected runner/contract are absent there and the installed Kilosort io.py hash is c6093e14cae920e8cfaae6c3fed8d4c6ca032b046d705ef9868ec171c7bf3c99, not the frozen hash. Satisfying v3 literally would require modifying occupied state and is prohibited.
occupied_path_conflict.consequence: After the missing wrapper source arrives, use an isolated successor bundle and a narrowly reviewed absolute-path/import-topology update; retain identical windows, eager/lazy construction, rtol=0, atol=0, mismatch_count=0, positive control, bounds and stop rules.

safe_bundle_plan: Receive and seal the exact wrapper commit/tree from any authorized source owner; verify commit/tree and all five SOURCE_BINDINGS.json file hashes.
Export DARTsort commit edcfe1b51d672b4136eb13cc78c0875da804b851 from its existing object database into a fresh isolated tree; do not checkout or alter the dirty repository.

Use the existing pristine Kilosort 4.0.27 source tree with io.py hash 767b76a0..., plus the frozen environment locks, to build a fresh isolated import root/environment; prove actual imported paths and hashes before any binary access.

Copy the exact reviewed runner and contract into the isolated namespace, then create a successor contract/runner changing only absolute path and import-composition bindings and adding explicit immutable tree/commit receipts. Obtain focused independent delta review and later coordinator/resource receipts before any real equality execution.
